title: Moved environments and absolute script paths
summary: Installed scripts normally contain absolute interpreter paths. Moving or copying an environment can leave its entry scripts pointing to an earlier location even when a Python symlink still exists.
checks: Inspect static Python shebang paths relative to the declared environment root.
Recreate the environment at its intended final path; validate application behavior through an independently authorized oracle.
limitations: Shell trampolines and env-based shebangs remain unknown; target scripts are never executed.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
